title: Imagined destination views

entries.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide architectural photograph for a prayer-room guide, 3:2 landscape, extremely carefully finished realistic materials and geometry. Create an imagined contemporary international airport quiet concourse viewed at human standing eye level, upright verticals and a natural 35mm architectural lens. A parked passenger aircraft is clearly visible through glazing in the CENTRAL third of the picture, with its nose and forward fuselage facing across the view. Modest navy upholstered airport seats, restrained brushed metal details, an oak acoustic ceiling, pale honed terrazzo, a glass airbridge outside. Clear uncluttered walking space. The composition is calm, believable and welcoming, like premium architectural editorial photography, not a luxury advertisement. Daylight filtered softly through windows; natural creamy whites, timber warmth and slate blue accents. Keep important airport cues around the centre so a narrow vertical crop remains recognisable. No doorway or door frame in foreground (the website supplies a separate physical door). No people, words, letterforms, logos, signage, brand names, generated maps or religious symbols. No superstructure fantasy, no impossible plane anatomy, no repeated seats or aircraft, no glossy CGI finish, no haze, no vignette. Not a depiction of any named airport. Natural fine grain and impeccable contact shadows.

Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the provided airport architectural photograph. Make its precisely aligned evening companion for dark mode in a prayer-room guide. Outside is blue hour with a deep muted blue sky; indoor existing ceiling lights and existing reading lights give gentle warm light. Add only realistic illumination, not new fixtures or objects. Natural restrained exposure: do not crush shadows, do not tint everything blue, no dramatic orange cast, no glow, no fog. If this is the airport, the aircraft and jet bridge remain clearly visible in modest apron lighting. If this is campus, library windows glow softly and the tree and path remain legible. If this is hospital, the corridor remains evenly and safely illuminated and the courtyard is visible. Preserve realism, material detail and calm. Do not add text, people, logos, signs, labels, symbols, moons or other decorative elements. No crop or change of viewpoint.
